SabanaPuerto:
STV2 GPIO ports — internal mapping to micro:bit pins.
* WARNING: board PORT 3 corresponds to micro:bit pin P8,
NOT pin P3. Verified in ORIGINAL/main.ts (p3 = AnalogPin.P8) and in
EXT4/blocks/smartteam4/puertos.ts (Ext4Puerto.P4 -> DigitalPin.P8).
*   PORT 0  ->  micro:bit P0
PORT 1  ->  micro:bit P1
PORT 2  ->  micro:bit P2
PORT 3  ->  micro:bit P8   <-- exception
bloques:
Parent category PADRE — the subcategories are groups (like SmartTEAM5).

MORSE blocks — ESPECIAL group.
* Redesign of the group (previously in mensaje.ts): 5 blocks instead of 3.
For now these are purely VISUAL blocks (no real internal logic),
pending definition of the actual Morse encoder/decoder implementation.
bloques.borrarMensajes: Clears the accumulated Morse message and translated message.
bloques.boton:
STV2-2 — Button connected to a GPIO port (pull-up, active high
logic: pressed=1, released=0).
bloques.botonLogico:
Combined boolean block for the Button (hexagon). The round block
"Button │ on pin %puerto" (blockId boton, with its own yellow
color and its own P0-P3 pin dropdown inside) is snapped
by default inside the hexagon, as a shadow block.
bloques.colorIniciar:
STV2-4 — Color sensor over I2C (address 0x10). Direct translation
of version-alex/block/veml6040.ts. GRAY COLOR: placeholder, final
visual design (text/id/color) still to be defined.
bloques.dht11:
STV2-3 — DHT11 (humidity/temperature) over I2C (address 0x27).
Sensor ranges: Humidity 20% to 90% RH · Temperature 0°C to 50°C
(integers, no decimals).
bloques.establecerCantidad: Sets a value for the Quantity variable.
bloques.guardarMensajeMorse: Saves the press of Button A as Morse code (dot/dash).
bloques.helice:
STV2-21 — Propeller on a GPIO port, simple ON/OFF. Reuses the
SabanaEstadoOnOff enum defined in led.ts (the direction control
from SabanaMovimientoMotorUnico is not used).
bloques.joystick:
STV2-8 — Joystick connected over I2C (address 0x61). GRAY COLOR:
placeholder, the final design is still pending definition by the user.
bloques.joystickDetecta:
STV2-8b — Joystick direction detection (round block, not a
hexagon: returns number 1/0 instead of boolean). Translation of
version-alex/block/joystick.ts -> rockerDetect(). Threshold ±50 on
the raw value (without the Y-axis sign inversion from the reporter
above). GRAY COLOR: placeholder, same criteria as the rest of the
Joystick.
bloques.lcdBorrar: STV2-13 — Clears all text on the LCD (I2C).
bloques.lcdEscribir:
STV2-12 — Writes text on the LCD over I2C (address 0x20, HD44780
4-bit protocol). The real LCD1602 has 16 columns x 2 rows.
bloques.led: STV2-10 — Simple LED on a GPIO port, with ON/OFF state.
bloques.leerCantidad: Returns the current value of Quantity.
bloques.luz:
STV2-7 — Light sensor (photoresistor) on a GPIO port.
Analog reading 0-1023.
* Code origin: ORIGINAL/block/sensorGPIO.ts -> Photosensitive()
return pins.analogReadPin(num)
* HISTORICAL NOTE: the original table said "Suelo" (Ground) due to a copy-paste
error from STV2-5. The text was already corrected to "Light Sensor" and should NOT be touched again.
* @param puerto board GPIO port, eg: SabanaPuerto.P0
bloques.mensajeMorse: Message in Morse code (dots/dashes) accumulated so far.
bloques.motorMulticolor:
STV2-16 — Controls an individual motor (identified by color/emoji)
connected over I2C. The "+" button adds the optional speed parameter.
Right = positive speed, Left = negative speed, Brake = 0.
bloques.movimientoCm:
STV2-18 — Movement over a distance in cm. Direct block, no
"+" button. Forward/Backward only (does not include turns or braking).
bloques.movimientoGirar:
STV2-19 — Turns the robot by a given angle. Direct block, no
"+" button. The word "Turn" is part of the dropdown text
(SabanaDireccionGiro), not the block's fixed text.
bloques.movimientoSimple: STV2-17 — Simple robot movement. Direct block, no "+" button.
bloques.oledBorrar: STV2-15 — Clears all text on the OLED (I2C).
bloques.oledEscribir:
STV2-14 — Writes text on the OLED (I2C), row 0-3, column 0-15.
Reuses the SabanaColumna16 enum defined in lcd.ts.
bloques.potenciometro:
STV2-6 — Potentiometer on a GPIO port (analog reading 0-1023).
* Code origin: ORIGINAL/block/sensorGPIO.ts -> Potentiometer()
return pins.analogReadPin(num)
* HISTORICAL NOTE: the original table had the text "Suelo en el puerto X"
(copied by mistake from STV2-5). It was corrected to "Potentiometer..." to
match the component. The text should NOT be touched again.
* @param puerto board GPIO port, eg: SabanaPuerto.P0
bloques.puertoToAnalogPin:
Converts a board port to the corresponding AnalogPin.
Use for analog reading (potentiometer, light, ground) and for servo.
bloques.puertoToDigitalPin:
Converts a board port to the corresponding DigitalPin.
Use for digital read/write (button, LED, propeller).
bloques.seguidorLinea:
NEW — Line follower over I2C (address 0x28), direct translation
of version-alex/block/lineFollower.ts. GRAY COLOR: placeholder,
final visual design (text/id/color) still to be defined.
bloques.sensorGrises:
NEW — 3-way grayscale sensor over I2C (address 0x29), direct
translation of version-alex/block/therrWayGray.ts. GRAY COLOR: placeholder,
visual design still to be defined.
bloques.servo: STV2-20 — Servo motor on a GPIO port, degree from 0 to 180°.
bloques.suelo: STV2-5 — Ground (line) sensor on a GPIO port.
bloques.tiraRgb:
STV2-9 — 6-LED RGB strip over I2C (address 0x24). Each LED is
chosen with a color picker (palette).
bloques.tiraRgbAjustada: STV2-11 — Sets the RGB strip with independent R, G and B values (0-255).
bloques.tiraRgbApagarTodos: NEW — Turns off all LEDs on the RGB strip.
bloques.traducirMensaje: Translates the accumulated Morse code into the corresponding letter.
bloques.ultrasonido:
STV2-1 — Ultrasonic sensor connected over I2C (address 0x23). Returns the
distance in centimeters, range 0 to 200.
* IMPORTANT: the third argument `true` of i2cWriteBuffer is a
repeated-start (no stop condition). It is required so that the
next read returns the requested register. Do NOT remove it.
bloques.ultrasonidoLogico:
Combined boolean block for the Ultrasonic sensor (hexagon). The
round block "Ultrasonic │ on I2C pin" (blockId ultrasonido, with
its own light-blue color) is snapped by default inside the
hexagon, as a shadow block.
* Detection threshold: 3 to 25 cm (inclusive), based on the reading in cm.
